title: Model Management Module
summary: This module oversees the entire lifecycle of AI models, from their initial creation and conversion to their efficient serving, scheduling, and integration with various applications and tools.

nodes.label: Model Creation & Conversion
nodes.title: Model Creation & Conversion
nodes.description: Handles the ingestion, validation, conversion (e.g., Safetensors, GGUF), quantization, and metadata configuration of raw model files into Ollama's internal format.

nodes.label: Model Serving & Scheduling
nodes.title: Model Serving & Scheduling
nodes.description: Manages the loading, execution, and efficient scheduling of models on available hardware resources, exposing them via HTTP endpoints and providing model information caching.

nodes.label: Model Launch & Integrations
nodes.title: Model Launch & Integrations
nodes.description: Orchestrates the launching of models for interactive use or embedding, and manages the configuration and execution of various external tools and integrations (e.g., Codex, Claude Desktop).

nodes.label: Raw Model Files & Modelfiles
nodes.title: Raw Model Inputs
nodes.description: Source model files in various formats (Safetensors, GGUF, Diffusers) and user-defined Modelfiles specifying creation instructions.

nodes.label: Ollama API Server
nodes.title: Ollama API Server
nodes.description: The central API server that exposes endpoints for model management, inference, and other core functionalities to clients.

nodes.label: Model Artifact Storage
nodes.title: Model Artifact Storage
nodes.description: Persistent storage for converted model layers, manifests, and other artifacts, managed by the data and storage module.

nodes.label: External Clients & Tools
nodes.title: External Clients & Tools
nodes.description: User applications, CLI tools, or external integrations that interact with Ollama models and services.

groups.label: Model Lifecycle Core
groups.title: Core Model Lifecycle
groups.description: The central components responsible for transforming, serving, and scheduling AI models within the Ollama ecosystem.

groups.label: User & Integration Layer
groups.title: User & Integration Layer
groups.description: Components that handle direct user interactions for model launching and manage integrations with external applications and tools.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: External systems and modules that provide inputs to or consume outputs from the model management process.
